title: John Barrow's anti-Kardashev scale and Omega-minus civilizations
summary: Andrew Gallimore tells of John Barrow's anti-Kardashev scale and Omega-minus civilizations, about 1990s at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: if you look at the anti-artership scale uh proposed by John Barrow in the 1990s

plain: A neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore points to an idea from the 1990s by John Barrow, a scientist, called the anti-Kardashev scale. The usual Kardashev scale ranks civilizations by how much energy they control, while Barrow's version ranks them by how small the things they can control are, with the most advanced, called Omega-minus, working at the tiniest scales. Gallimore raises it because it would mean truly advanced beings might be hard to see at all.
